question.text: There are three bags <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">B</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub><mo>,</mo><mtext> </mtext><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">B</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math> and <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">B</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub><mo>.</mo></math> The bag <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">B</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub></math> contains <math><mn>5</mn></math> red and <math><mn>5</mn></math> green balls, <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">B</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math> contains <math><mn>3</mn></math> red and <math><mn>5</mn></math> green balls, and <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">B</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub></math> contains <math><mn>5</mn></math> red and <math><mn>3</mn></math> green balls, Bags <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">B</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub><mo>,</mo><mtext> </mtext><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">B</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math> and <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">B</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub></math> have probabilities <math><mfrac><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>10</mn></mrow></mfrac><mo>,</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>10</mn></mrow></mfrac></math> and <math><mfrac><mrow><mn>4</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>10</mn></mrow></mfrac></math> respectively of being chosen. A bag is selected at random and a ball is chosen at random from the bag. Then which of the following options is/are correct?

options.text: Probability that the selected bag is  <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">B</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub></math>  and the chosen ball is green equals  <math><mfrac><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>10</mn></mrow></mfrac></math>
Probability that the chosen ball is green equals  <math><mfrac><mrow><mn>39</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>80</mn></mrow></mfrac></math>

Probability that the chosen ball is green, given that the selected bag is  <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">B</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub><mo>,</mo></math>  equals  <math><mfrac><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>8</mn></mrow></mfrac></math>

Probability that the selected bag is  <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">B</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub><mo>,</mo></math>  given that the chosen balls is green, equals  <math><mfrac><mrow><mn>5</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>13</mn></mrow></mfrac></math>

solution.text:
Let us define following events
B1 : Event of selection of bag 1 ( 5 Red, 5 Green)
B2  : Event of selection of bag 2 ( 3 Red, 5 Green)
B3 : Event of selection of bag 3 ( 5 Red, 3 Green)
R= Event of selection of Red ball
G= Event of selection of Green ball
Option (C) :
PGB3=38 (as bag 3 has been selected now total balls in bag 3=8, green ball =3 )
Option (B) :
PG=PB1PGB1+PB2PGB2+PB3PGB3
=310×510+310×58+410×38
=3980
Option (D) :
PB3G=PB3∩GPG
=PB3PGB3P(G)
=410×383580 ∴ PG=3980
=413
Option (A) :
PB3∩G=PB3PGB3
PB3∩G=PB3PGB3
=320
